scope: Fixed 504-update boundary-weighted head. Compare original neural fields with neural-seeded and RGB-clustered paper palettes using the existing illumination-aware mixture helper. All 16 real training photos and 96 synthetic original/scene/printed views scored at 320; same 32 source-separated development photos reviewed at source-resolution colour classification. Body, model, annotations and source/crop data unchanged. No training, per-photo winners or deployment.

protocol.display: Palette evaluated on original RGB in 128-row strips; thresholded mask nearest reduced for gallery, body display unchanged. No full-size field is saved.
protocol.validation: Require exact current network training and synthetic metrics. Retain calibration failures and all 32 photos. Use an RGB-only control and inspect both printed and shading failures; do not interpret lower interior training error as template recovery.
protocol.fitterFollowup: Only after visual review, rectify original RGB with frozen crops and apply declared palettes before fresh fitting. Keep every attempted method and failed crop.
